title: Pregnant Solo #40
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Pakistani woman, an adult, in her late 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a professional female bodybuilder physique, carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps, wide flaring lats, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep — and projecting forward from her hard, muscular middle, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its surface taut and round even where the muscle around it stays hard and defined. Diamond-shaped calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, braided hair, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver a hair ornament. Full body painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework, a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of concentric ripple linework wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme cream extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
